# When should a consignment shop mark things down, and what should it decline?

> Paste the items in your consignment or resale shop and get the exact best markdown schedule for each, which items to decline at intake, and how much a fixed 30/60-day rule leaves on the table. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
